body.heading: The list that only grows
paragraphs: A to-do list can feel like it never shrinks, because finished items vanish while new ones arrive. Your effort disappears from view the moment it succeeds.
A done list fixes the accounting. Every completed thing, large or small, gets written down and stays there, visible proof of a day that was not wasted.

body.heading: Write it at the speed of life
paragraphs: Keep the done list wherever it is easiest: the back of your planner, a notes app, a whiteboard. Add things as you finish them, including the unglamorous: forms sent, calls made, rooms tidied.
At the end of the week, read it once. You will usually find the week was fuller than your memory claimed, especially the parts that helped other people.

takeaway: Track what you finished, not only what remains, and let the record encourage you.
